function.name: postsider_list_channels
function.description: List the connected social channels for this organization. Returns each channel's id, name and platform. Call this before postsider_create_post to get a valid channel id for posts[].integration.id. Forwards to GET /public/v1/integrations.

function.name: postsider_get_agency_overview
function.description: Get an organization-wide operational overview for an agency: clients, channels, queued posts, drafts, published posts, errors, recent errors and pending approvals. Forwards to GET /public/v1/overview.

function.name: postsider_get_customer_report
function.description: Get a customer-scoped agency report with channels, queued, draft, published, error and pending approval counts. Forwards to GET /public/v1/customers/{customerId}/report.

function.name: postsider_list_groups
function.description: List configured channel groups (sets of channels that are published to together). Forwards to GET /public/v1/groups.

function.name: postsider_find_slot
function.description: Get the next free scheduling slot for a channel, per its posting queue. Forwards to GET /public/v1/find-slot/{id}.

function.name: postsider_list_posts
function.description: List posts scheduled or published within a date range (UTC). Forwards to GET /public/v1/posts.

function.name: postsider_get_post
function.description: Get the full organization-scoped post group, including current state, scheduled time, media, channel and publish error. Forwards to GET /public/v1/posts/{id}.

function.name: postsider_get_post_missing_fields
function.description: Get per-channel validation problems for a post before it can be published. Forwards to GET /public/v1/posts/{id}/missing.

function.name: postsider_get_post_analytics
function.description: Get performance analytics for a single post over the last N days. Forwards to GET /public/v1/analytics/post/{postId}.

days.description: Number of days to look back. Default 7.

function.name: postsider_get_channel_analytics
function.description: Get account-level analytics for a connected channel (where the provider supports it). Forwards to GET /public/v1/analytics/{integration}.

function.name: postsider_get_notifications
function.description: List recent notifications for the organization (publish failures, channels needing reconnection). Forwards to GET /public/v1/notifications.

function.name: postsider_upload_media_from_url
function.description: Download an image or video from a public URL into the media library and return the resulting media object. Pass it as images to postsider_create_post. Forwards to POST /public/v1/upload-from-url.

function.name: postsider_create_post
function.description: Create, schedule, or immediately publish a post across one or more channels. type: schedule books it for date; now publishes immediately; draft saves without publishing. Forwards directly to POST /public/v1/posts.

function.name: postsider_update_post_status
function.description: Change the status of an existing post (draft to schedule, or back). Forwards to PUT /public/v1/posts/{id}/status.

function.name: postsider_delete_post
function.description: Permanently delete a scheduled or draft post by id. Forwards to DELETE /public/v1/posts/{id}.

function.name: postsider_request_approval
function.description: Send a draft post into the human approval queue. The post must already exist as a draft. Forwards to POST /public/v1/posts/{id}/request-approval.

function.name: postsider_get_approval_status
function.description: Check the approval status of a post that was sent for human review (approved, rejected with the reviewer's note, or pending). Returns NONE if never submitted. Forwards to GET /public/v1/posts/{id}/approval.
